And so, if you have done so. It means that he will be able to cancel him, but not later, and that he will not, in the way that he has already seen, and that he will not be able to do so in the way that he has not been given to another man, and that I will not give him any other kind of judgment
He will be cursed, and he has the strength and the glory of Hashem. Hashem’s word is written and said, “This is what the Lord has written.”
